process.title: From first message to final gallery

s1.title: Tell us about it
s1.text: Send a short inquiry with date, place and occasion. We answer personally, usually within 24 hours.

s2.title: We plan together
s2.text: A quick call or chat about mood, timing and the people who matter. No stiff posing, promise.

s3.title: The day itself
s3.text: We arrive early, stay unobtrusive and let the moments happen — you just celebrate.

s4.title: Your gallery
s4.text: A curated, edited online gallery to download, share and print — delivered within about two weeks.

q1.a: All over Berlin — parks, cafés, your home, rented venues. Brandenburg and further away on request.

q2.q: How far in advance should we book?
q2.a: Weekends fill up quickly, so ideally 3–6 weeks ahead. Short notice? Just ask — sometimes it works.

q3.q: How do we receive our photos?
q3.a: As a private online gallery in high resolution, ready to download, share and print.

q4.a: We move indoors, use covered spots or reschedule outdoor couple sessions free of charge.

q5.a: Yes — we work in German and English, so everyone at your celebration feels at home.

q6.q: Can we share the photos on social media?
q6.a: Of course. We only ask for a mention if you’re happy to — and we never post your photos without your permission.
